msContents.summary: This is a paper manuscript of the Itihāsasamuccaya.

msItem.title: Itihāsasamuccaya
msItem.finalRubric:
iti śrīmahābhārate itihāsasamuccaye saṃsārakūpavarṇaṃ nāma trayastriṃśattamo '
dhyāyaḥ || 33 ||
msItem.colophon:
saṃvat || 1834 || mārgaśiraśudi || 11 || ravivāsare || likhataṃ gokalamuvādamadhye pāṭha
nārthīya bāharalāla athavā tatputabhikṣārāma śubham astu maṃgalaṃ dadātu śrī hariḥ || śrīrāmāyanayo namaḥ

lg.l: kathayaṃtaṃ hi tīrthānāṃ prabhāvān adbhutāṃs tatho ||
lomaśaṃ tatra dharmajñaṃ paryāpṛchad yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || 1 ||

yo rakṣet
prāṇināṃ brahman_ bhayārttaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ ||
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yat syāt tan me brūhi tapodhana || 2 ||

ekataḥ kratavaḥ
sarve samagravaradakṣiṇā ||
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇaṃ || 3 ||
idam eva purā devās tulayā samalolayan
prāṇirakṣaṇam eveha gauravenātiricyate || 4 ||
atraivodāharaṃtīmam itihāsaṃ purātanaṃ ||

iṃdrasyāgneś ca saṃvādaṃ śiva¦
r auśīnarasya ca || 5 ||
varttamāne mahāyajñe jijñāsārtha śivaṃ nṛpaṃ ||
iṃdra śyena kapoto gnir bhūtvā tatropajagmatuḥ || 6
atheti bhūpatiṃ prāpya kapotaḥ śyenajād bhayāt ||
śaraṇārthī mahīpālaṃ nilabhye bhayavivhalaṃ || 7 ||

tataḥ śanair upāgamya
śyenarūpī sureśvaraḥ ||
rājānaṃ sa mahātmānanaṃ provācedaṃ vacas tadā || 8 ||

dharmātmānaṃ tvāṃ mahābāhum ekaṃ rā
jan mahīpatiṃ ||
sa tvaṃ dharmmaviruddhaṃ hi kathaṃ dharmma cikīrṣasi || 9 ||
bhavān kṛtaghnaṃ dānena satyenānṛtabhāṣaṇaṃ ||

kṣama
yā kūrakarmāṇam asādhyaṃ sādhunā jayet || 10 ||
nopakārakṛteṣv evam upakāraparo janaḥ ||

apakārapare pi tvam upakāra
paro yathā || 11 ||
ahite hitabuddhitvaṃ pāpe pi tvam apāpakṛt ||
doṣānveṣeṇa dakṣe pi guṇānveparaḥ || 12 ||

ta
d ayaṃ vihito bhakṣyaḥ pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā ||
mā hiṃsī labhato dharmaṃ dharmam utsṛṣṭavān asi || 13 ||

saṃtrastarūpo¦
śaraṇārthī tvatto bhīto vihaṃgamaḥ ||
matsakāśam anuprāpya prāṇagṛdhnurayaṃ khagaḥ || 14 ||

tad evam āgatasyāsya kapotasya¦
bhayārthitaḥ ||
katham asmadvidhāḥ kuryyus tyāgaṃ sadbhir vigarhitaṃ || 15 ||
lobhād veṣād bhayād vāpi yastyajet śaraṇāgataṃ ||

brahma
hatyābhavat tasya pāpam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 16 ||
śāstreṣu niṣkṛti draṣṭā mahāpātakinām api ||

śaraṇāgatahaṃtrīṇāṃ¦
niḥkṛtir na vidhīyate || 17 ||
yathātmanā priyāḥ prāṇāḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ dhruvaṃ ||

tasmān mṛtyubhayatrastās trātavyāḥ prāṇi¦
no budhaiḥ || 18 ||
janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhaiḥ nityaṃ saṃsārasāgare ||
jaṃtavaḥ parikliśyaṃti sasyati tān tataḥ paraṃ || 19 ||

yasmā
n nityaṃ bhavec chokas trāto vā krodha eva vā ||
āyaso vā yato mūlam ekajātaṃ parityajet || 20 ||

mariṣyāmīti yad duḥkhe
puruṣasyopajāyate ||
yuktaṃ tenānumānena paro pi parirakṣati || 21 ||

yathā hi te jīvatam ātmano pṛthaṃ tathā pareṣām api
jīvitaṃ priyaṃ ||
sa rakṣase jīvitam ātmano yathā tathā pareṣām api rakṣa jīvitaṃ || 22 ||

tasmān nāhaṃm imaṃ bhītam arpa
yiṣye kapotakaṃ ||
yad atra yuktam anyaṃ te karttuṃ śyenāśu tad vada || 23 ||

āhārābhū saṃbhavaṃti
janeśvara ||
āhāreṇa vivarddhaṃte tena jīvaṃti jaṃtavaḥ || 24 ||
śakyate nyai vināpy arthai rājan_ varttayituṃ ciraṃ ||

hāravi
hīnena śakyaṃ varttayituṃ kvacit || 25 ||
bhakṣyād vilokitasyāsya mama prāṇa viśāṃ pate ||

visṟjya kāyaṃ yāsyaṃti paṃthānam a
punarbhavaṃ || 26 ||
mṛte ca mayi sarvaṃ me putradārā mariṣyati ||
rakṣyamāṇakapotaṃ taṃ bahūn prāṇān_ ca rakṣasi || 27 ||

dharmmaṃ yo bādha
te dharmo na sa dharma paraṃtapa ||
avirodhitapo dharmaḥ sa dharmaḥ sadbhir ucyate || 28 ||

tasmād virodhe dharmasya viciṃtya gurulā
ghavaṃ ||
atibhūyāṃs tato rājan_ kuru dharmavinirṇayaṃ || 29 ||

nosmād bhūyaḥ paro dharmaḥ kaścid anyo sti kheca
ra ||
prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānāṃ abhayaṃ yat pradīyate || 30 ||
varam ekasya satvasya pradattābhayadakṣiṇā ||

na tu viprasahasrasya gosaha
sram alaṃkṛtam || 31 ||
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāparaḥ ||
tasya dehād vimuktasya na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || 32 ||

hemadhe
nudharādīnāṃ dātāraḥ sulabhā bhuvi ||
durlabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarvabhūtābhayapradaḥ || 33 ||

mahatām api yajñānāṃ kālena kṣī
yate phalaṃ ||
bhītābhayapradānasya kṣaya eva na vidyate || 34 ||
dattam annaṃ tapas taptaṃ tīrthasevā śrutaṃ tathā ||

sarvāny abhaya
dānasya kalāṃ nārhatiṃ ṣoḍaśīṃ || 35 ||
catuḥsāgaraparyyaṃtāṃ yo dadyāt pṛthivīm imāṃ ||

abhayaṃ yaś ca bhūtebhyo tayor abha
yado dhikaḥ || 36 ||
api tyajed rājyam idaṃ śarīraṃ vā sudustyajaṃ ||
na tv imaṃ bhayasaṃtrastaṃ tyajed dīnaṃ kapotakam || 37 ||

yan mamāsti
śubhaṃ kiṃcit tena janmani janmani ||
bhaveyam aham ārttānāṃ prāṇinām ārttināśikaḥ || 38 ||

na cāhaṃ kāmayed rājyaṃ na svargaṃ
nāpunarbhavaṃ ||
prāṇināṃ bhayataptānāṃ kāmaye duḥkhanāśanaṃ || 39 ||
yathā ca nānṛtā vāṇī mamaiṣā samuhṛtā ||

satyena tena bhagavā
n_ prasīdatu mahīśvaraḥ || 40 ||
āhārārthaṃ samāraṃbhas tava cāyaṃ vihaṃgamaḥ ||
yady atheṣṭaṃ tavāhāram anyam eva vadāmy aham || 41 ||
sa eva vihato bhakṣaḥ dhātrāsmākaṃ kapotakaḥ ||
tam evotsṛjya nāhāraiḥ kāryyam anyair janeśvara || 42 ||

śye
nā kapotān_ khādaṃti śrutir eṣā sanātanī ||
mā rājan_ sāram ajñātvā kadalīskaṃdham āruha || 43 ||

nāham ku
śāstramārgeṇa kvacid vartte vihaṃgamaḥ ||
śāstrair evopadiṣṭo yaṃ dharmaḥ satvadayāparaḥ || 44 ||

sarvasatvapradānāc ca dayaivaikā
viśiṣyate ||
sarvavedānu tat kuryyuḥ sarve yajñāś ca khecara || 45 ||
sarvatīrthābhiṣekaś ca yat kuryāt prāṇināṃ dayāṃ ||

vāṅma
naḥkarmabhir ye tu sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ || 46 ||
dayādarśitapaṃthāno brahmalokaṃ vrajaṃti te ||

gachatas tiṣṭato vāpi jāgrataḥ
svapito pi || 47 ||
yan na bhūtahitārthāya tatpaśor iva ceṣṭitaṃ ||
jaṃgamāni ca bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi
tmavat parirakṣaṃti te vai yāṃti parāṃ gatiṃ ||
prāṇanaṃ vadhyamānaṃ tu yaḥ śaktaḥ samupekṣate || 49 ||

ti nara
ti prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ ||
rājyaṃ samastaṃ sumahat prayachāmi tava dvija || 50 ||
yad vā kāmayase hy anya varjjayitvā kapotakaṃ
yadi rājan kapoteṣu sudṛḍhā prītir īdṛśī || 51 ||
tataḥ kapotatulyāni svamāṃsāni prayacha me
anugraham imaṃ manye yan māṃ śyenābhibhāṣase || 52 ||
tat te haṃ saṃprayachāmi svamāṃsaṃ yāvad ichasi ||

ya
di priyaṃ vastu janā na vadaṃti vadaṃti ca || 53 ||
mama tu priyam evaitat kasmād abhihitaṃ cirāt ||

adhruveṇa śarīreṇa
pratikṣaṇavināśitā || 54 ||
dhruvaṃ yo nājayed dharmaṃ sa śocyo mṛḍhacetanaḥ ||

yadi prāṇyupakārāya deho yaṃ nopajāya
te || 55 ||
tataḥ kiṃm upacāro sya pratyayaṃ kriyate vṛthā ||

nātiriktam ahaṃ yāce tava māṃsaṃ janeśvara ||¦
56 ||
tasmāt kapotena dhṛtaṃ prayacha tulayā ||
tad evāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yan māṃ śyenābhibhāṣase || 57 ||
yenāsya rakṣaṃm eva syāt tathā tava vihaṃgama ||
evam uktā svamāṃsāni samutkṛtya sa pārthivaḥ || 58 ||
prahṛṣṭe tulayāmāsa kapotena saha prabhuḥ ||
tyaktātmasukhabhogechāṃ sarvabhūtahitaiṣiṇaḥ || 59 ||

bhavaṃti para
khena sādhavo nityaduḥkhitā ||
dhṛyamāṇas tu tulayā kapoto vyatiricyate || 60 ||

punaś cotkṛtya māṃsāni tataḥ prā
pārthivaḥ ||
na vidyate yadā māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ kvacit || 61 ||
tataḥ kṣīṇamāṃso sau cāruroha tulāṃ svayaṃ ||

paraduḥkhani
vṛttāni sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ || 62 ||
nāpekṣaṃte mahātmānaḥ svaduḥkhāni mahāṃty api ||

atha tasmin samārūḍhe tulām auśī
nare nṛpe || 63 ||
divyaduṃdubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta haḥ ||
tatas tasya tadā matvā devarājo dhṛtiṃ parāṃ || 64 ||

śakrasya
rūpam āsthāya vākyam etad abhāṣata ||
iṃdro ham asmi bhadraṃ te kapoto havyavāḍayaṃ || 65 ||

jijñāsyamānau
tvāṃ rājan_ imaṃ yajñam upāgatau ||
naitat sarve nṛpā cakruḥ kariṣyaṃti cāpare || 66 ||

mahākāruṇikeneha yat kṛtaṃ duḥ
kṛtaṃ tvayā ||
parārthe tyajataḥ prāṇān_ yā prītir abhavat tava || 67 ||
prāṇasvāṃsayalubdheṣu na sā prāṇeṣu dehināṃ ||

parārthai
kāṃtikalyāṇi svāsayātyaṃtaniṣṭurā || 68 ||
tavaiva kevalāṃ rājan_ karuṇā taruṇāyate ||

svakarmapāśaiś ca dṛḍhair baddhaṃ
kṛtsnam idaṃ jagat || 69 ||
tvaṃ jagadduḥkhamokṣārthī baddhakaruṇayā nṛpa ||

yathā sarvātmanā cāpi doṣeṣu yat kṛtaṃ tva
yā || 70 ||
tathā caivātmanaḥ je vāsano pi na vidyate ||
akṛtvaiśaṃ viśiṣṭebhyo hinān anavamanya ca || 71 ||

akṛ
tva sadṛśaiḥ sparddhāṃ tvaṃ lokottamatāṃ gataḥ ||
paropakārajanmāno vidhātrā vihitās trayaḥ || 72 ||

sajalā jaladās tvaṃ ca sa
phalāś ca phalo drumāḥ ||
ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇān_ yo naraḥ parirakṣati || 73 ||
sa yāti paramaṃ dhāmayato nāvarttate punaḥ ||

prā
ṇair api tvayā rājan_ rakṣitaḥ kṛpaṇo khagaḥ || 74 ||
svamāṃsāny api dattāni dravyeṣv anyeṣu kā kathā ||

paśavo pi hi jīvaṃti
kevalāsodaraṃbharāḥ || 75 ||
na punar jīvati ślāghyo yaḥ parārthaṃ hi jīvati ||
kim atra citraṃ yat saṃtaḥ parānugrahatatparāḥ || 76
na hi svadehaśītāya yajaṃte caṃdanadrumāḥ ||
paropakāravyavahāraparo yaḥ puruṣaḥ sadā || 77 ||

sa yadi padam āpnoti parād a
pi hi yat paraṃ ||
paropakāraviṣayā svasukhāya gataḥ spṛhāḥ || 78 ||
jagaddhitāya jāyaṃte sādhavas tv ādṛśā bhuvi ||

yat sva
māṃsāni gātrebhyaḥ samutkṛṃtāni pārthivaḥ || 79 ||
eṣā te sātvikā kīrtti lokān anugamiṣyati ||

divyarūpadharaś cai
va pālayitvā ciraṃ mahī ||
sarvalokān anukramya brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyasi || 80 ||

evam uktā tam iṃ¦
drāgnī jagmatus tridaśālayaṃ ||
rājāpi kṛtam iṣṭāpi mumude devavac ciraṃ || 81 ||

ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śiveś ca
ritam uttamaṃ ||
śivarūpe hi sā yāti prayāti tridivaṃ naraḥ || 82 ||

viciṃtya rājā svaśarīram adhruvaṃ dhruvaṃ yaśaḥ
sarvaśarīradurlabhaṃ ||
śarīradānāt parajīvarakṣaṇaṃ vidhāya lokatrayabhūṣaṇaṃ yayau || 83 ||

body.p:
śrīmahābhārate iti
hāsasamuccaye śyenakapotīya nāma caturtho dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||
